title: 八角奏乐亭 Bajiao Zouyue Ting
subtitle: west octagonal music pavilion · Xiyang Lou

model.line: Simple massing of a European palace: position and footprint from the ruin, the plan or a survey, heights read from the plates of the 1780s (research/xiyanglou/boxes.csv). Not a detailed model yet; the figures and their methods are in the Dimensions block.
rows: octagonal music pavilion, two storeys: 8.7 × 8.7 m, eave 9.3 m, ridge 12.5 m
corridor, 9 bays, curved on the plates; a straight run here: 49.3 × 4 m, eave 8.8 m, ridge 9.6 m
by the stone kit, the kit's reading of the plates, C, not a detailed model

evidence.title: Plate II: 谐奇趣 Xieqiqu, south front (by content)
evidence.excerpt_other: Sur le sol de cette seconde terrasse sont placées à droite et à gauche deux galeries en hémicycle, lesquelles ne s'élèvent que jusqu'au niveau de la première terrasse.
evidence.summary: Round stair with a double ramp and a niche with a throne; a basin with vases and animals, birds and quadrupeds spouting; a dolphin in the centre; octagonal pavilions at the ends of the galleries; on the left a triumphal arch with a European dial; a three-arch bridge. Delatour's Plate II matches Malone's Engraving 1.

evidence.title: Engraving 1: 谐奇趣 Xieqiqu, south front
evidence.excerpt_other: A three-story building in the center was joined by curved galleries to two two-storied towers at the southeast and southwest of the main building.
evidence.summary: Curved stairs from the second floor down to a pool with several fountains between galleries and towers; a lake with a balustrade in front. Capitals mix Corinthian and Ionic (p.143).

photos.title: 谐奇趣南面 (圆明园铜版画册 / 西洋楼铜版画, plate 一 of 二十; title and number printed on the plate)
photos.creator: 伊兰泰 Yi Lantai (drawings); engraved by court workshops
photos.archive: 故宫博物院 Palace Museum, Beijing
photos.why: Printed title; the two octagonal music pavilions and the south pool stand on the plate. Viewer looks north: XY01-01 (west) is on the left, XY01-N01 (east) on the right. Roof behind the west colonnade; arcaded water structure with gate tower at the left edge.
photos.attribution: Yi Lantai, 1786, 故宫博物院 Palace Museum, Beijing, via Wikimedia Commons
photos.visible: west octagon, whole, at left, with stair of the west colonnade end

photos.creator: anonymous (holder)
photos.archive: Slovenski etnografski muzej, Skuškova zbirka; portal East Asian Collections in Slovenia
photos.why: Album: "Ruinen des Theaters und Bibliothek". Two-storey block at left has the form of 蓄水楼 in Sirén 004533. Reeds as on P0186. Pier, columns and reeds of P0172, P0186; the cluster at left stands where the west octagon was.
